offering_description.value: Operates casual full-service restaurants (Flanigan's Seafood Bar and Grill) and package liquor stores (Big Daddy's) in South Florida. Sells meals, drinks, beer, wine and spirits to consumers, and franchises some restaurants.

primary_products.value: beer, wine and spirits at retail; prepared meals and drinks

primary_services.value: full-service restaurant dining; bar service; restaurant franchising

customer_segment.value: B2C: restaurant diners and liquor store shoppers in South Florida

end_markets.value: restaurants and hospitality; package liquor retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: food, drinks and packaged liquor sold to consumers; commissions or management fees: royalties and fees from franchised restaurants
revenue_model.category: product sales; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys liquor, food and beverages from distributors and sells to consumers in own stores; asset operator: owns and runs restaurants and bars and franchises units to operators

geography_served.value: US regional: South Florida, mainly Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties and the Keys

specialization.value: related lines: restaurants and package liquor stores under shared alcohol-focused hospitality operations

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants, bars and package liquor stores; other: franchised restaurants operated by franchisees

regulatory_exposure.value: high: alcohol licensing under Florida beverage laws, also health and food safety rules
